overview: The MPS School Committee reviewed the Interim Superintendent's self-evaluation and state of the district presentation, and received an update on the high school building project. The committee also approved the 2026–2027 district school calendar and routine consent items.

items.title: Officer Election Resolution and Swearing-In Status
items.summary: The committee passed a resolution maintaining current officers until the next scheduled meeting election, while two members noted they must abstain from votes until officially sworn in.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, including bills, payrolls, capital purchases, donations, grants, field trips, and prior meeting minutes.

items.title: Interim Superintendent Evaluation and Strategic Goals
items.summary: Interim Superintendent Dr. Suzanne Galusi presented her self-evaluation, detailing district progress in leadership stabilization, instructional coherence, operational management, and future strategic goals.

items.title: 2026–2027 District School Calendar
items.summary: The committee approved Option A for the 2026–2027 district school calendar, establishing September 2, 2026, as the first day of school for students.

items.title: Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee Update
items.summary: Building Committee Chair Jenny Graham outlined recent educational planning sessions, traffic and existing condition surveys, and upcoming public input forums leading to the preliminary design submission.
